Test Case Description: Verify Customs Search screen loads successfully with all search filters
Test Steps:
1. Login as authorized user.
2. Navigate to Customs Search screen.
3. Verify all search filters and controls are displayed.
Expected Result: All search parameters, buttons and controls should be displayed successfully.

Test Case Description: Verify search using a valid combination of basic filters
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Customs Search screen.
2. Select Charge Country, Entity, Charge Group, Charge Code and Charge Status.
3. Click Search.
Expected Result: System should display records matching all selected filters.

Test Case Description: Verify Charge Group controls available Charge Codes
Test Steps:
1. Select Charge Group as Cost.
2. Verify available Charge Codes.
3. Change Charge Group to Revenue.
4. Verify Charge Codes again.
Expected Result: Cost should display ECD, ECS, EC3. Revenue should display DTA, DTC, DTS and DT3 only.

Test Case Description: Verify search using Date Type and valid date range
Test Steps:
1. Select Date Type.
2. Select Start Date.
3. Select End Date.
4. Click Search.
Expected Result: Records should be filtered according to selected Date Type and date range.

Test Case Description: Verify End Date cannot be earlier than Start Date
Test Steps:
1. Select Start Date.
2. Select an End Date earlier than Start Date.
3. Click Search.
Expected Result: System should display validation message and prevent search execution.

Test Case Description: Verify search using Business Type, Account Type and Category filters
Test Steps:
1. Select Business Type.
2. Select Account Type.
3. Select Category.
4. Click Search.
Expected Result: Search results should satisfy all selected filter values.

Test Case Description: Verify search using different Search Criteria values
Test Steps:
1. Select Search Criteria as Tracking Number.
2. Search using valid Tracking Number.
3. Repeat for Console, Account Number and BOE.
Expected Result: System should return matching shipment records for each search criteria.

Test Case Description: Verify Multiple Tracking Number search functionality
Test Steps:
1. Select Search Criteria as Tracking Number.
2. Click Multiple button.
3. Enter multiple Tracking Numbers.
4. Click Search.
Expected Result: System should return matching records for all entered Tracking Numbers.

Test Case Description: Verify Additional Details filters functionality
Test Steps:
1. Enable Additional Details toggle.
2. Select Origin Entity, Origin Country, Destination Entity, Destination Country, Third Party Entity and Third Party Country.
3. Click Search.
Expected Result: Search should return records matching the selected additional filters.

Test Case Description: Verify search using multiple filter combinations
Test Steps:
1. Select filters from Basic Search and Additional Details.
2. Enter valid search values.
3. Click Search.
Expected Result: System should return only records satisfying all selected conditions.

Test Case Description: Verify system displays "No records found" when no matching data exists
Test Steps:
1. Enter filter values that do not match any shipment.
2. Click Search.
Expected Result: System should display "No records found" message.

Test Case Description: Verify search results are accurate with database records
Test Steps:
1. Perform search using known shipment data.
2. Compare search results with database records.
Expected Result: UI search results should match database records.

Test Case Description: Verify search performance for large result sets
Test Steps:
1. Perform search with broad criteria.
2. Measure search response time.
3. Verify records are loaded successfully.
Expected Result: Search should complete within acceptable response time without UI issues.

Test Case Description: Verify user can perform consecutive searches without refreshing the page
Test Steps:
1. Perform first search.
2. Modify filter values.
3. Perform another search.
4. Repeat multiple times.
Expected Result: Each search should return accurate results without requiring page refresh.

Test Case Description: Verify Hide Filters button availability and default state on Search screen
Test Steps:
1. Login as an authorized user.
2. Navigate to the Customs Search screen.
3. Observe the Hide Filters button before performing a search.
4. Perform a valid search.
5. Verify the state of the Hide Filters button after search results are displayed.
Expected Result: Hide Filters button should be visible in an Inactive state on initial page load and should become Active only after search results are displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify filter section collapses successfully using Hide Filters button
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the Customs Search screen.
2. Perform a valid search.
3. Click the Hide Filters button.
4. Observe the filter section, search results area and button label.
Expected Result: Filter section should collapse, search results should expand to occupy available space and button label should change to Show Filters.

Test Case Description: Verify collapsed filter section can be expanded using Show Filters button
Test Steps:
1. Collapse the filter section.
2. Click the Show Filters button.
3. Observe the filter section and search results area.
4. Verify the button label.
Expected Result: Filter section should expand to its original position, search results should resize accordingly and button label should change back to Hide Filters.

Test Case Description: Verify filter values are retained after collapsing and expanding the filter section
Test Steps:
1. Enter values in multiple search filters.
2. Perform a search.
3. Click Hide Filters.
4. Click Show Filters.
5. Verify all previously entered filter values.
Expected Result: All previously entered filter values should remain unchanged after collapsing and expanding the filter section.

Test Case Description: Verify user can continue searching after toggling filter visibility multiple times
Test Steps:
1. Perform a valid search.
2. Collapse and expand the filter section multiple times.
3. Modify one or more filter values.
4. Perform another search.
5. Verify the search results.
Expected Result: System should continue functioning normally, filter values should remain editable and search results should be returned correctly after toggling.

Test Case Description: Verify user can search and select a value from searchable dropdown
Test Steps:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to any screen containing a searchable dropdown.
3. Click the dropdown.
4. Enter a valid keyword in the search box.
5. Verify filtered results.
6. Select the required value.
Expected Result: Dropdown should filter matching values dynamically as the user types, and the selected value should be populated successfully.

Test Case Description: Verify search behavior when no matching value exists in the dropdown
Test Steps:
1. Open any searchable dropdown.
2. Enter a keyword that does not match any available value.
3. Observe the search result.
Expected Result: System should display "No Records Found" (or equivalent message) and should not allow an invalid selection.

Test Case Description: Verify search functionality is case-insensitive across all searchable dropdowns
Test Steps:
1. Open a searchable dropdown.
2. Search using lowercase, uppercase and mixed-case characters for the same value.
3. Compare the results.
Expected Result: Search results should be identical irrespective of letter case, and the correct value should be displayed and selectable.
